agents.apiKeyEncryptionInfo: API keys are encrypted with AES-256-GCM and stored in the database. They are decrypted server-side for API requests.

globalProviderPreference.title: Default Agent
globalProviderPreference.subtitle: Preferred provider for auto-selection. Used when a role has no individual override.
globalProviderPreference.recheckTitle: Re-probe CLI / API and discard cache
globalProviderPreference.footerNote: Only checks whether the CLI responds (API keys are not checked; 5-minute cache)

skipPermissionToggle.title: Skip agent permission prompts
skipPermissionToggle.onDescription: Launches Claude Code with <code1>--dangerously-skip-permissions</code1> and Codex / Gemini with <code2>--yolo</code2>. Execution never pauses, so be aware it edits files and runs commands immediately.
skipPermissionToggle.offDescription: Surfaces the CLI's standard permission prompt. Safer, but the task pauses each time a question comes up during execution.

missSignatures.title: Detection-Miss Signature Review
missSignatures.subtitle: Approve or reject detection cues learned from defects that slipped past the quality gates. Approved cues land in the knowledge base as hints for future research and detector work.

basis.initial_gate: Initial learning period — every suggestion needs human approval until the review record reaches the configured count
basis.insufficient_data: Insufficient data — window samples are below the floor, so no judgement is made (auto-apply stays off)
basis.low_rejection: Rejection rate at or under the threshold — pending suggestions auto-apply
basis.high_rejection: Rejection rate over the threshold — auto-apply stopped, back to approval required

missSignatures.empty: No suggestions are waiting for review. Periods without misses are normal — no detection is expected.
